title: Ahsan Manzil reference views for dedicated Y-up model review
policy: Source files are downloaded only for a repeatable review package. SHA-1 is pinned to the Commons-listed original-file checksum; SHA-256 is computed at run time and copied into the review manifest. No automated image-similarity score determines a match.
license: Each source image is separately licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 by its listed author; image files must remain unmodified and must be accompanied by this attribution in every review package.

references.title: Ahsan Manzil-Front View.jpg
references.author: Mahbub Hossain Shaheed (mahosha)
references.attribution: Mahbub Hossain Shaheed (mahosha), “Ahsan Manzil-Front View.jpg”, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons. Source image retained unmodified.
references.note: Commons caption identifies this as a front view. The centered dome/main stair composition is mapped to the model's south river-facing +Z facade; the image metadata does not independently provide a camera heading.

references.title: Ahsan Manzil Side View.jpg
references.author: Parvezahmed
references.attribution: Parvezahmed, “Ahsan Manzil Side View.jpg”, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons. Source image retained unmodified.
references.note: Commons records a camera point at 23.708196 N, 90.406732 E. The model anchor is 23.7086 N, 90.40606 E with [C] confidence, placing the camera provisionally southeast of the site. The nearest fixed turntable camera is 315 degrees in Blender world; this is a best-estimate viewpoint match, not a calibrated camera pose.
references.mappingConfidence: [C] approximate camera point and source georeference anchor; nearest available fixed azimuth is 315 degrees; camera heading and lens calibration unknown
